name: – Nathalie Loiseau – § 24 – Am 13
title: REPORT on EU-Syria political relations
part_text: 24. Recalls that over 400 000 Palestine refugees are residing in Syria, some of them displaced multiple times, and notes the role of UNRWA in providing humanitarian, education, health and protection services to these Palestine refugees in Syria; remembers the siege of the Yarmouk camp between 2013 and 2015 by factions affiliated with the Assad regime, which itself was supported by Iran;
